notes: Background: Northbridge is a mid-market RevOps SaaS (plan + CRM enrichment) evaluating Redwood to power a new in-product AI assistant + embeddings-based doc search.
Orig flow: started with Hosted API POC (Dec 2025 -> Jan 2026) to validate quality and latency; moved to Dedicated demo + perf tests Feb 2026.
POC results: hosted API met quality targets but jitter under peak was a concern; dedicated demo showed 2x improvement in p95 tail latency under similar load.
Workload profile: chat-first product; short utterances (avg 40-80 tokens) + periodic large embedding batches for nightly index updates (~50k docs).

Targets: p50 <= 150ms for typical chat turn, p95 <= 400ms; sustained throughput target ~200 concurrent chat sessions with bursts to 600 concurrent sessions; nightly embedding throughput ~10k docs/hour.
Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit economics predictable. Interested in 6-month pilot of Dedicated with committed GPUs and a rollback path to Hosted if SLA misses.
Model prefs: wants ability to route to lighter quantized variants for high-throughput paths and fall back to higher-quality variants for escalation flows. Needs model pinning and rollout control.
Routing/fallback: require smart routing policy by tier (prod -> dedicated, fallback -> hosted-compatible model) + prefix cache for repeated queries.
Security/Compliance asks summarized from security call: SSO/SAML, audit logging retention 2 years, KMS integration, data residency for EU customers, DPA edits on subprocessor approval.

Legal thread: NDA executed 2025-11-20. Current MSA redlines from Northbridge legal (sent 2026-03-01) focusing on indemnity cap, IP carveouts for customer prompts, termination for convenience, SLA credits calculation.
